links.note: Looking up 'you may take it that', 'he seems to be coming round' and 'my foot's gone to sleep' - all of them lines of the characters' speech, which is what carries this play (24243).
Why Lomov says it is impossible for him not to marry - his age, his nerves and his practical need for a settled life. That is 24245's account of him.
What the meadows are worth - three hundred roubles. A detail of the Oxen Meadows quarrel, which is 24248.
The anger-management task on the ill-effects of a quick temper - it follows directly from two characters losing theirs over trifles, which is 24250.
That the proposal was forgotten amid the argument, and what the right approach would have been - the triviality of the quarrels in 24250.
